scope: public COUNTRY_OFFICIAL_DOCS: FR BE NL IE; applicability assessment only, never an automatic legal approval
validation_standard: The URL may be an official original PDF yet not be a required, accepted, or appropriate document for the user's CRDS scenario. Check Romanian authority acceptance separately.

FR.review_note: DGP France country reference dated 2022. Subsidiary Carte Vitale/licence evidence only under specific already-CRDS circumstances; no automatic substitution for first CRDS.

BE.review_note: 2021 EU-wide catalogue gives example types, NOT a personal proof of Belgian domicile, annex 19 approval or Romanian CRDS accepted document checklist.

NL.review_note: IND 8004 applies to qualifying long-term permanent residence applications (normally at least five years). It is NOT an automatic CRDS form, BRP extract, or proof of Dutch domicile.

IE.review_note: EUTR2 is a conditional permanent residence certificate application, NOT a default document all Romanian citizens need for CRDS. PPS/IRP also must not be presented as universal proof.

mandatory_before_sale: Confirm actual country-specific Romanian CRDS requirements from DGP/consulate, including the acceptability of each named foreign source
Ensure conditional foreign applications are not labeled default forms needed by everyone
Show explicit label for source type: Romanian CRDS reference, foreign residence application, or illustrative document
Validate actual PDF links, titles and previews in Safari mobile and browser desktop
Approve each exact private guide with dated evidence and manual review; preserve sale_approved=NO until then
